king.name: Settlement Chief
text: Welcome to the Rust Horizons Free Zone.
You've crossed a lot of wasteland to get here, and that earns respect.

prisoner.name: Prisoner
text: Oh hey there, it's been so long since I've seen a new face.
I've been trapped here for ages.
But you'll probably be fine to be honest.
I'm guessing you did something to get in here?
Let me let you in on a little secret.
This whole world is a prison.
I don't even think it's real.
I think it's just a simulation.
I think we're all just a simulation.
I think I'm just a simulation.
I think you're just a simulation.
Anyway, hang in there and when your time runs out,
You can just teleport back.
As for me, I'll stay here...
Forever...

villagegirl.name: Wife
text: Please, call me Azaria.

villagegirl2.name: Scrap Scavenger
text: Another day, another chem-storm survived!

villagegirl3.name: Wastelander
text: Watch the radiation levels out there, yeah?

villagegirl4.name: Rust Runner
text: Got any spare parts? Always looking to trade.

villagegirl5.name: Dust Dweller
text: The wasteland's rough, but we survive.

villagegirl6.name: Zone Survivor
text: Keep your head down and your fusion cells loaded.

villagegirl7.name: Junktown Local
text: Welcome to Junktown, try not to get irradiated.

forestnpc.name: Scavenger
text: Good day to you!

miner.name: Prospector
text: Back off! I'm extracting rare minerals from this irradiated hellhole!

miner2.name: Rock Breaker
text: Get lost! These tech-nodes won't extract themselves!

beachnpc.name: Bubba
text: Well, thanks for the help.
Not really doing much but thanks regardless.
Though I did hear some crunbling east of here, a cave might've opened up.
This might just be an urban legend but it is said that an entire
underworld exists beneath the surface of this beach.

agent.name: Secret Agent
text: Hello there, would you be so kind as to assist me?
It seems I have stumbled upon this strange phenomenon.
You see, this cave I am heavily guarding appears to be
exhibiting a warm-hole like situation.
Regardless, I feel its best to send a stup-
I mean, a capable survivor in there rather than me.

herbalist.name: Doc Salvage
text: Need meds, wastelander?
I patch up survivors... for a price.
Got any Rad-Away on ya?

rick.name: Rick
text: We're no strangers to love...
You know the rules and so do I...
A full commitment's what I'm thinking of...
You wouldn't get this from any other guy...
I just wanna tell you how I'm feeling...
Gotta make you understand...
Never gonna give you up...
Never gonna let you down...
Never gonna run around and desert you...
Never gonna make you cry...
Never gonna say goodbye...
Never gonna tell a lie and hurt you...
We've known each other for so long...
Your heart's been aching but you're too shy to say it...
Inside we both know what's been going on...
We know the game and we're gonna play it...
And if you ask me how I'm feeling...
Don't tell me you're too blind to see...
Never gonna give you up...
Never gonna let you down...
Never gonna run around and desert you...
Never gonna make you cry...
Never gonna say goodbye...

(Give you up)

Inside we both know what's been going on...

guard.name: Zone Enforcer
text: We're seriously busy securing the perimeter.

guard2.name: Command Guard
text: Any form of defiance will be met with death.

lavanpc.name: Dying Soldier
text: Thank you for all your help. I will perish in your absence.

boxingman.name: Bike Lyson
text: Woosh.

doctor.name: Doctor
text: I'm a doctor, not a miracle worker.

coder.name: The Archivist
text: Well, well... A survivor with potential.
You've escaped the Ashfall Wastes. Congratulations.
Listen carefully. Your first task is to understand what remains of this world.
The data-logs scattered across the wasteland hold secrets.
Go. Scout the ruins. Talk to the survivors in Junktown.
Once you've gathered enough information, return to me.
We need to find The Spark before The Overmind consumes what's left.

villager.name: Settler
text: Stay frosty, survivor!

villager2.name: Wastelander
text: Watch for Raiders on the outskirts!

villager3.name: Zone Dweller
text: Another day in the wasteland...

villager4.name: Rust Walker
text: Tech-storms rolling in tonight. Stay inside!

octocat.name: Octocat
text: Hey there!
I am the Octocat, the programmer and I
are very well acquainted.
In case you did not know, Rust Horizons is completely open-source.
You can check out the source on GitHub!

pirategirlnpc.name: Raider Captain
text: You looking for trouble, or just passing through?

snowshepherdboy.name: Sherpa
text: Hello, survivor!
Hope the mountain route is treating you well!

royalguard.name: Command Guard
text: There shall be no trespassing!

royalguard2.name: Command Guard
text: There shall be no trespassing!

royalguard3.name: Command Guard
text: There shall be no trespassing!

santaelfnpc.name: Santa's Helper
text: What do you want? I'm busy being overworked.

oldlady.name: Wasteland Elder
text: Hello there, survivor!
Stay careful out there in the ruins.

ratnpc.name: Rat
text: Squeak!

blacksmith.name: Forge Engineer
text: Hi!

blacksmith2.name: Forge Engineer
text: Hi!

rickgf.name: Lena
text: Oh, it's been so long since I've seen another soul.
Have you seen my love, Rick?

archivist.name: The Archivist
text: Welcome, Spark Seeker. I am what remains of the Elder Archivist, preserved in this Data-Pad.
You carry the burden of humanity's last hope.
Project Genesis lies dormant in The Citadel of the Architects.
The Overmind guards it jealously, determined that we should not rise again.
But The Spark still flickers within you. Follow its call.
The fate of the Rust Horizons rests in your hands.

fixer_finch.name: Fixer Finch
text: Well, well, what do we have here? Another fresh face in Junktown.
Listen kid, survival out there is all about gear.
Bring me rare components from the Toxic Bog, and I'll outfit you with tech that'll keep you alive.
I've kept soldiers, prospectors, and desperate fools alive with my upgrades.
You look like you might actually have a shot at this Spark Seeker nonsense.
Got any scrap metal to trade?

vesper.name: Vesper
text: Name's Vesper. I'm a Lead-Slinger, one of the best in these wasteland.
If you're looking to take on the Iron Hounds and The Overmind's forces, you'll need combat training.
I run bounties for those brave—or foolish—enough to take them on.
Rad-Ghouls in the Toxic Bog? Drone Patrols on the Rail Lines?
I've got work for anyone willing to bleed for the cause of The Spark.
What'll it be, Seeker? You got the guts?

kael.name: Kael
text: Greetings, traveler. I am Kael, a keeper of the old knowledge.
My years have been spent in meditation and study of the old world.
The Overmind fears what it does not understand, and the old world's wisdom is its greatest threat.
I can teach you about the relics you'll find, the nature of The Citadel, and why The Spark matters.
Many before you have sought The Spark. Few have returned.
But the old texts speak of one who would finally succeed. Perhaps that is you.
